implementation: Narrow join-filter projections precede payload gathering; rejected pairs never materialize full payload. Contiguous gathers and already-gathered columns are reused.
Preserve final tag13 streamed ordering, FULL/LEFT/RIGHT duplicate and null staging fixes, including key groups spanning freezes/batches.

Buffered expressions cache once per covered key-group range; streamed expressions evaluate once per index run. Only positively proven deterministic, row-local and nonthrowing expressions are eligible.
Comet proof bridge reuses existing CaseWhen closed whitelist and attaches a transparent PrecomputeSafeExpr immediately before SMJ construction. Arbitrary expression rewriting drops the marker.
Unknown/UDF/stateful and potentially failing expressions remain unhoisted. Lack of volatility/throwable metadata is not a safety proof.
Join-only Spark fallback protects nested AND/OR whose RHS is not proven eager-safe; native CASE/IF and safe TRY_CAST remain covered.

Fix zero-column TRUE/FALSE/NULL filter semantics with explicit batch row count. Fix speculative residual evaluation on synthetic unmatched outer rows; evaluate only actual equal-key candidate positions and preserve null-extended output.
Keep upstream requiredChildDistribution delegation and cover AQE skewed REBALANCE. Register restored fuzz/new ANSI suites permanently on both CI platforms; no temporary switch or full CI run.

retained_memory_limitations: Tag13 cache computes arrays before accounting and uses infallible grow after allocation; cache replacement/drop balances declared charge but can overcommit. Expression/filter scratch and FFI/shared buffers are not an RSS bound. G05 does not redesign pools or claim OOM safety.
